definitions.name: G1C.MIN
definitions.body: 'G1C.R' BIND G1C.R G1C.R 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1C.RANGE
definitions.note: max minus min of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1C.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G1C.NV' BIND G1C.NV G1C.NV G1C.MIN - G1C.NV G1C.RANGE /
definitions.note: rescale each number to (x - min) / (max - min)

definitions.name: G1C.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'G1C.C' BIND G1C.C [ 1 ] TAKE JOIN UPPER G1C.C [ 1 ] DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first character of a non-empty String

definitions.name: G1C.UNWORDS
definitions.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: G1C.TITLECASE
definitions.note: capitalize every space-separated word of a String

definitions.name: G1C.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word of a String

definitions.name: G1C.LONGEST
definitions.note: character count of the longest word in a String

definitions.name: G1C.LONGWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of words longer than 3 characters, original order
